## 3. Runtime dependencies through sockets (rule 5)

A package sends an op to a server that answers for a module it doesn't list in its
`package.json`. A gate op belongs to the module the gate's own `moduleOf()` gives it (the
module that switches it on and off); a helper's ops to the helper's package. The sites may
send anything and are left out.

| Package | Needs, undeclared | Through |
|---|---|---|
| apps | files | `sitefs:list` |
| areas | files | `sitefs:dirs`, `sitefs:files-read`, `sitefs:list`, `sitefs:markers`, `sitefs:protect`, `sitefs:unprotect` |
| core | apps | `apps:list` |
| core | files | `sitefs:list` |
| core | mail | `mail:visitor` |
| files | apps | `apps:list` |
| forms | examples | `gate:example.files`, `gate:example.reset`, `gate:examples.state` |
| forms | files | `sitefs:install-pages`, `sitefs:list` |
| getting-started | files | `sitefs:files-list` |
| getting-started | form-links | `gate:formlinks.for-database` |
| getting-started | forms | `gate:forms.state` |
| hosts | areas | `gate:route-area.set` |
| monitoring | mail | `mail:notice` |
| projects | studio | `pammydb:project-database` |
| services | areas | `gate:deletions.list`, `gate:deletions.told` |
| settings | apps | `apps:mail-get`, `apps:mail-set`, `apps:mail-test` |
| settings | areas | `gate:visitor-settings.get`, `gate:visitor-settings.set` |
| settings | forms | `gate:forms.state` |
| settings | mail | `mail:status`, `mail:test` |
| studio | areas | `gate:record-labels.keep`, `gate:record-labels.put`, `gate:record-touches.take` |

### What each site names

Today a site imports and names the modules it puts together; C1 makes them compose from
definitions instead.

- **lfdln** (21): api-keys, areas, catalog, comments, examples, files, form-links, forms, help, hosts, mail, media, monitoring, people, php, projects, requests, services, settings, studio, thumbs
- **pammy** (23): api-keys, apps, areas, catalog, comments, examples, files, form-links, forms, getting-started, help, hosts, mail, media, monitoring, people, php, projects, requests, services, settings, studio, thumbs

## 5. What the report couldn't place

- op `files-version-restore` in packages/files/src/panel/routes/editor.ts: not handed straight to a client

## 6. What it can't see

- SQL a string doesn't hold whole: a table name put in with `${}` or `sql(name)`, a statement
  built from pieces joined at run time, or comma joins (`FROM a, b`: only `a` is read).
- SQL in `db/migrations` and `packages/*/migrations` (they make tables; the owner is who makes
  them), in `test/`, `tools/` and `deploy/`, and in SQLite (the media index: `prepare` / `exec`
  on a `DatabaseSync`).
- Which process runs a file is read from its path (`src/gate/`, `packages/gate/`) and a short
  list in `tools/coupling/scan.ts`; a file used by both sees the tables of the one its path says.
- An op request built in one place and sent in another (section 5 lists them), and requests
  through a client the tool doesn't know (it stops on a new JSON-line server).
- A module named any other way than its exact name: a socket path, a URL, a nginx location,
  a right called differently.
- Coupling through files on disk (`gate-routes.json`, the media index, a helper's records).
- Who a baseline table belongs to is by meaning (`BASELINE` in the tool), not found.
